2.211.9
MapColorScale.LabelInterval
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapColorScale.LabelInterval element specifies the interval between labels in a MapColorScale.
This element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an Integer ([XMLSCHEMA2/2]
section 3.3.17) or an expression that evaluates to an Integer. If this element is not present, its value
is interpreted as 1.
The following is the parent element of the MapColorScale.LabelInterval element.
Parent elements
MapColorScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapColorScale.LabelInterval element.
 <xsd:element name="LabelInterval" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
